doc: Resize an FP32 channel-first image while preserving its layout and format.
NCHW and CHW storage are supported. Nearest sampling follows the donor OA
floor-coordinate rule. Bilinear sampling uses half-pixel centers with
`align_corners = false`. Area performs a coverage-weighted box average
for downscales and pixel replication for upscales, matching `INTER_AREA`.
Cubic uses the Keys a=-0.75 bicubic kernel over the 4x4 source
neighborhood, and Lanczos uses the a=4 sinc kernel over the 8x8 source
neighborhood with the filter widened by the inverse scale when
downscaling, matching `INTER_CUBIC` and `INTER_LANCZOS4`.
The call records work asynchronously and returns an Image immediately.
Reading its backing matrix is an explicit submission and observation point.
# Errors
Returns an error for a zero target extent, an empty source extent, a dtype or
layout outside the admitted checkpoint, checked-size overflow, or a runtime
recording failure.
Extract a region, clipping its right and bottom edges to the source extent.
Flip an image horizontally, vertically, or along both axes.
Rotate clockwise by a multiple of 90 degrees.
Add asymmetric padding with an explicit border policy.
Extract a centered region with the requested exact extent.
Resample an image from an FP32 absolute-coordinate map shaped
`[1|batch, 2, output_height, output_width]`.
Apply an inverse FP32 2x3 affine transform to an image.
Apply an inverse FP32 3x3 perspective transform to an image.
Replace values above `threshold` with `max_value` and all others with zero.
Replace values at or below `threshold` with `max_value` and all others with zero.
Truncate values above `threshold`.
Replace values at or below `threshold` with zero.
Replace values above `threshold` with zero.
Produce `true_value` for values inside the inclusive interval and zero outside it.
Clamp every pixel to the inclusive interval.
Invert every value around `max_value`.
Apply `value * contrast + brightness`.
Apply `max(value, 0)^gamma * gain`.
Invert values at or above `threshold` around `max_value`.
Quantize `[low, high]` to `levels` evenly spaced values using round-half-up.
Convert an RGB or RGBA image to Rec.709 grayscale.
Blend two equal semantic images using `left * (1-alpha) + right * alpha`.
Composite two equal images with a clamped Gray or per-channel mask.
Fill the intersection of a rectangle and the image with one finite value.
Apply one shared FP32 `[3, 4]` affine color transform to RGB channels.
Reorder one to four channels and explicitly assign the resulting format.
`order[c]` selects the source channel for output channel `c`. The output
format must have the same channel count as the input so pixel data and
semantic metadata cannot diverge.
Add explicit-seed Philox Gaussian noise to every pixel.
Replace a seeded fraction of pixels with salt or pepper values.
Apply same-shape 2D cross-correlation with an odd FP32 kernel up to 31×31.
Apply horizontal and vertical odd FP32 vector kernels up to length 31.
Average an odd rectangular neighborhood up to 31×31.
Compute one first-order Sobel derivative.
Compute one first-order Scharr derivative.
Apply the four-neighbor discrete Laplacian.
Erode with an odd rectangular structuring element up to 31×31.
Dilate with an odd rectangular structuring element up to 31×31.
Erode and then dilate with the same rectangular element.
Dilate and then erode with the same rectangular element.
Return dilation minus erosion.
Apply a normalized Gaussian blur with replicate borders.
Apply a nonnegative four-neighbor sharpening amount.
Select the median of an odd square neighborhood up to 15×15.
Apply a bilateral neighborhood filter.
Apply an unsharp mask using a Gaussian detail estimate.
Return the source minus its morphological opening.
Return the morphological closing minus the source.
Threshold against the local arithmetic mean minus `c`.
Threshold against a local Gaussian-weighted mean minus `c`.
Apply `(pixel - mean[channel]) / std[channel]` to up to three channels.
Convert between three-channel RGB and BGR semantics, including identity.
Bilinearly resize and normalize in one semantic and executable operation.
Blend a class palette over an RGB/RGBA image using an I32 label map.
Accumulate a per-plane histogram over an FP32 NCHW or CHW image.
Each `(batch, channel)` plane contributes one row of `bins` buckets to the
U32 result whose leading dimensions mirror the image; `[B,C,H,W]` and
`[C,H,W]` inputs produce `[B,C,bins]` and `[C,bins]` results. Values below
`lower` or at or above `upper` are ignored; in-range values map uniformly
onto `[0, bins)`. The accumulator is cleared inside the operation, so a
captured plan replays the same counts.
# Errors
Returns an error unless `bins` is in `1..=256`, `lower` and `upper` are
finite with `lower < upper`, the image is nonempty FP32 NCHW/CHW, and all
sizes fit the shader ABI.
Equalize a normalized FP32 image histogram per `(batch, channel)` plane.
Pixel values are quantized into 256 uniform buckets over `[0, 1]`, the
per-plane cumulative distribution is spread back over `[0, 1]` following
the `equalizeHist` contract, and the result keeps the input layout and
format. Values outside `[0, 1]` clamp into the edge buckets.
# Errors
Returns an error unless the image is nonempty FP32 NCHW/CHW and all
sizes fit the shader ABI.
Compare two same-shape U32 histogram matrices row by row.
The last dimension is the bucket axis; every leading index is an
independent row, so `[B,C,bins]` histograms produce a `[B,C]` FP32 score
matrix. Correlation, chi-square, intersection, and Bhattacharyya follow
the OpenCV `compareHist` formulas; degenerate rows return `0.0` rather
than propagating a zero denominator.
# Errors
Returns an error unless both inputs are same-shape nonempty U32 matrices
of rank at least two on one runtime, and all sizes fit the shader ABI.
Halve an FP32 image with the `pyrDown` Gaussian-decimate contract.
Each output pixel gathers the 5x5 `[1, 4, 6, 4, 1]` Gaussian
neighborhood centered on the doubled source coordinate, following
OpenCV's `BORDER_DEFAULT` (reflect-101) edge rule. Output spatial
extents are `(extent + 1) / 2` per axis; layout and format are
preserved.
# Errors
Returns an error unless the image is nonempty FP32 NCHW/CHW and all
sizes fit the shader ABI.
Double an FP32 image with the `pyrUp` interpolate-blur contract.
The source is upsampled by two with zero rows and columns at odd
positions, then convolved with the 5x5 `[1, 4, 6, 4, 1]` kernel
scaled by four, following OpenCV's `BORDER_DEFAULT` (reflect-101)
edge rule on the upsampled grid. Output spatial extents are `2 *
extent` per axis; layout and format are preserved.
# Errors
Returns an error unless the image is nonempty FP32 NCHW/CHW and all
sizes fit the shader ABI.
Binary-threshold an FP32 image with a histogram-selected level.
Each `(batch, channel)` plane is quantized into 256 uniform buckets
over `[0, 1]`; the Otsu or Triangle method selects one threshold per
plane following the OpenCV `THRESH_OTSU`/`THRESH_TRIANGLE` contracts,
and pixels strictly above it produce `max_value` while all others
produce `0.0`. Returns the thresholded image together with the
per-plane threshold Matrix shaped like the leading dimensions.
# Errors
Returns an error unless the image is nonempty FP32 NCHW/CHW,
`max_value` is finite, and all sizes fit the shader ABI.
Compute the per-plane summed-area table of an FP32 image.
Following the `integral` contract, the result is a `(height + 1)`
x `(width + 1)` FP32 Matrix per `(batch, channel)` plane whose
zero row and column border the inclusive prefix sums: element
`(y, x)` holds the sum over source pixels `[0, y) x [0, x)`. The
leading dimensions are preserved ahead of the enlarged spatial
extents.
# Errors
Returns an error unless the image is nonempty FP32 NCHW/CHW,
enlarged extents stay nonzero, and all sizes fit the shader ABI.
Convert an FP32 image between color spaces following `cvtColor`.
The conversion code owns the color-space contract, matching
OpenCV's `COLOR_*` pairs: channel-ordered inputs admit the
`Rgb`/`Bgr` sources and `Gray` admits the gray sources. The
output carries `Gray` for luminance results, `Rgb` for
gray-to-color results, and the input format otherwise; the
color-space interpretation of three-channel results follows the
conversion code exactly as it does for `cv::Mat`. HSV keeps
OpenCV's F32 ranges (H `[0, 360]`, S/V `[0, 1]`); Lab uses the
D65 XYZ intermediate (L `[0, 100]`, a/b signed); YCrCb applies
the F32 0.5 chroma offset.
# Errors
Returns an error unless the image is nonempty FP32 NCHW/CHW and
the source channel count matches the conversion.
Map a single-channel FP32 image to RGB through a colormap.
Each luminance value is clamped to `[0, 1]` and mapped by the
admitted analytic colormap definition (`Jet`, `Hot`, `Hsv`, or
`Rainbow`) to an RGB triplet, producing a three-channel Rgb
image per plane following the `applyColorMap` contract.
# Errors
Returns an error unless the image is nonempty FP32 NCHW/CHW
with a single channel.
Back-project a per-plane U32 histogram onto an FP32 image.
Each pixel is quantized with the `calc_hist` rule over
`[lower, upper)` into `bins` buckets taken from the histogram's
last dimension; the output pixel carries the histogram count as
an FP32 value, or `0.0` when the source falls outside the range.
Histogram leading dimensions must equal the image's leading
plane dimensions, following `calcBackProject`.
# Errors
Returns an error unless the image is nonempty FP32 NCHW/CHW,
the histogram is a nonempty U32 Matrix of matching leading
shape, `lower`/`upper` are finite with `lower < upper`, and all
sizes fit the shader ABI.
Contrast-limited adaptive histogram equalization per plane.
Each plane is split into `tile_width` x `tile_height` tiles,
quantized into 256 uniform buckets over `[0, 1]`, clipped at
`clip_limit` times the per-bin average with the excess spread
uniformly, and remapped through bilinear-interpolated tile
lookup tables following the `CLAHE` contract.
# Errors
Returns an error unless the image is nonempty FP32 NCHW/CHW,
`clip_limit` is finite and positive, both tile extents are
nonzero, and all sizes fit the shader ABI.
Add one image to a running accumulation image elementwise,
following `accumulate`. Both images must share shape, layout,
and format; the result is a fresh F32 image, not an in-place
update.
# Errors
Returns an error unless both images are nonempty FP32
NCHW/CHW images with identical shape, layout, and format.
Blend an image into a running average as
`input * alpha + accumulator * (1 - alpha)` per element,
following `accumulateWeighted`.
# Errors
Returns an error unless both images are nonempty FP32
NCHW/CHW images with identical shape, layout, and format and
`alpha` is finite.
Compute the ten spatial moments `m00, m10, m01, m20, m11, m02,
m30, m21, m12, m03` per image plane through a serial per-plane
reduction, following `cv::moments`. The result Matrix carries
the image's leading plane dimensions plus a final extent-10
moment dimension.
# Errors
Returns an error unless the image is a nonempty FP32
NCHW/CHW image and all sizes fit the shader ABI.
Peak signal-to-noise ratio per image plane in decibels,
following `cv::PSNR`: `10 * log10(peak^2 / mse)` through a
serial per-plane reduction, `+inf` when the planes match
exactly. The result Matrix carries the image's leading plane
dimensions.
# Errors
Returns an error unless both images are nonempty FP32
NCHW/CHW images with identical shape, layout, and format and
`peak_value` is finite and positive.
Global structural similarity per image plane through a serial
per-plane reduction of means, variances, and covariance with
the standard `K1=0.01, K2=0.03` constants over a `[0, 1]`
dynamic range, following the SSIM index of Wang et al. rather
than OpenCV's windowed map. The result Matrix carries the
image's leading plane dimensions.
# Errors
Returns an error unless both images are nonempty FP32
NCHW/CHW images with identical shape, layout, and format.
Slide a single-plane template over each image plane and write the
per-position match score to a Matrix, following `matchTemplate`.
The template's channel count must equal the input's; the output
carries the input's leading plane dimensions plus
`(height - th + 1) x (width - tw + 1)` score elements computed by
a serial per-position reduction over the template window.
# Errors
Returns an error unless both images are nonempty FP32 NCHW/CHW
images with matching channel counts, a single-plane template no
larger than the image planes, and sizes that fit the shader ABI.
Warp each image plane to polar coordinates about a center, following
`warpPolar`: output row `y` is the angular axis `[0, 2pi)` and column
`x` is the radial axis — `x / width * max_radius` under `Linear` or
`max_radius^(x / width)` under `SemiLog`. Source samples gather with
the admitted interpolation and border policy.
# Errors
Returns an error unless the image is a nonempty FP32 NCHW/CHW
image, the center and radius are finite with `max_radius > 0`, the
output extent is nonzero, `border_value` is finite, and all sizes
fit the shader ABI.
Canny edge detection per plane: 3x3 Sobel gradient magnitude,
non-maximum suppression along the quantized gradient direction,
double thresholding, and bounded hysteresis relaxation.
Pixels at or above `high_threshold` are strong edges; pixels at
or above `low_threshold` are weak and are kept only when
8-connected to a strong edge. `hysteresis_passes` bounds the
relaxation passes (edge chains longer than the bound are cut);
zero selects `height + width` per plane. Output planes carry
1.0 on detected edges and 0.0 elsewhere.
# Errors
Returns an error unless the image is a nonempty FP32 NCHW/CHW
image and both thresholds are finite with
0 <= low_threshold <= high_threshold.
Connected-component labeling per plane, following
`connectedComponents`: every pixel above `threshold` is a
foreground candidate and receives a unique initial label;
bounded min-label propagation merges neighbors under the
selected connectivity (4 or 8). The U32 output carries
plane x height x width labels with `u32::MAX` on background
pixels. `propagation_passes` bounds label propagation (zero
selects `height + width` per plane); components with
diameters beyond the bound resolve to sub-components.
# Errors
Returns an error unless the image is a nonempty FP32
NCHW/CHW image and `threshold` is finite.
Distance transform per plane, following `distanceTransform`:
every pixel above `threshold` measures the chamfer distance
to the nearest background pixel. `DistanceType::L1` uses a
4-neighborhood with unit weights (exact Manhattan distance);
`DistanceType::L2` uses an 8-neighborhood with weights
1 / sqrt(2), the classic 3x3 chamfer approximation. The F32
output carries plane x height x width distances, zero on
background. `propagation_passes` bounds the relaxation
(zero selects `height + width` per plane, the worst-case
propagation distance).
# Errors
Returns an error unless the image is a nonempty FP32
NCHW/CHW image and `threshold` is finite.
Standard Hough line transform per plane, following
`HoughLines`: pixels above `edge_threshold` vote into a
(theta x rho) accumulator quantized by `theta_step`
(degrees over [0, 180)) and `rho_step`. Accumulator cells
reaching `threshold` votes that are strict local maxima in
their 3x3 theta-rho neighborhood emit lines. The F32 output
carries plane x `max_lines` x 3 rows of (rho, theta degrees,
votes) in compacted unsorted order; unused rows are zero.
# Errors
Returns an error unless the image is a nonempty FP32
NCHW/CHW image, `edge_threshold`/`rho_step`/`theta_step`
are finite, `rho_step`/`theta_step` are positive,
`theta_step` does not exceed 180, and `max_lines` is
nonzero.
Probabilistic Hough segment transform per plane, following
`HoughLinesP`: votes accumulate as in `hough_lines`, strict
local-maxima cells above `threshold` emit candidate lines,
and each candidate is walked along its direction to find
the dominant contiguous edge run that tolerates gaps of up
to `max_line_gap` pixels and reaches `min_line_length`.
The F32 output carries plane x `max_lines` x 4 rows of
(x1, y1, x2, y2) endpoints; line slots without a qualifying
run are zero.
# Errors
Returns an error unless the image is a nonempty FP32
NCHW/CHW image, `edge_threshold`/`rho_step`/`theta_step`
are finite, `rho_step`/`theta_step` are positive,
`theta_step` does not exceed 180, `min_line_length` is
nonnegative, and `max_lines` is nonzero.
External contour extraction per plane, following `findContours`
with `RETR_EXTERNAL` semantics: foreground pixels above
`threshold` are labeled as connected components under the
selected connectivity, each component's minimum-index
boundary pixel seeds a Moore-neighbor trace that emits an
ordered `(x, y)` point list. Returns an F32
`[planes, max_contours, max_points, 2]` point matrix and a U32
`[planes, max_contours]` length matrix; unused slots stay zero.
`max_points` bounds each contour (zero selects
`4 * (height + width)`; longer contours truncate), and
`max_contours` bounds the per-plane contour count.
`propagation_passes` bounds component labeling (zero selects
`height + width`). Contour order and slot assignment are
unspecified across planes.
# Errors
Returns an error unless the image is a nonempty FP32
NCHW/CHW image, `threshold` is finite, and `max_contours` is
nonzero.
Floating-range flood fill per plane, following `floodFill`:
the pixel at `(seed_x, seed_y)` takes `value`, and each
unmarked pixel joins the region when a connected neighbor
already belongs and the candidate's original value lies within
`[neighbor - lo_diff, neighbor + up_diff]` of that neighbor's
original value. Propagation runs a fixed number of relaxation
passes (zero selects `height + width`); regions whose flood
diameter exceeds the bound fill partially. The output is a
filled copy of the input; unmarked pixels keep their values.
# Errors
Returns an error unless the image is a nonempty FP32
NCHW/CHW image, the seed is in bounds, and `value`,
`lo_diff`, and `up_diff` are finite with `lo_diff >= 0` and
`up_diff >= 0`.
Draw a straight segment over a copy of the input, following `line`:
each pixel whose center lies within `thickness / 2` of the
`(x1, y1)-(x2, y2)` segment takes `color`; all other pixels copy the
input. Coordinates are continuous pixel units and `color` applies to
every plane. No anti-aliasing is applied.
# Errors
Returns an error unless the image is a nonempty FP32 NCHW/CHW image,
all coordinates and `color` are finite, and `thickness` is positive
and finite.
Draw a rectangle border or fill over a copy of the input, following
`rectangle`: `(x, y)` gives the top-left corner in pixel units and
`width`/`height` the extent. A positive `thickness` draws a border
band that many pixels wide measured inward from the rectangle edge;
a nonpositive `thickness` fills the rectangle. `color` applies to
every plane.
# Errors
Returns an error unless the image is a nonempty FP32 NCHW/CHW image,
all coordinates and `color` are finite, `width` and `height` are
positive, and `thickness` is finite and nonzero.
Draw a circle ring or disk over a copy of the input, following
`circle`: `(cx, cy)` is the center in pixel units. A positive
`thickness` draws a ring whose band is that many pixels wide around
`radius`; a negative `thickness` fills the disk. `color` applies to
every plane.
# Errors
Returns an error unless the image is a nonempty FP32 NCHW/CHW image,
`cx`, `cy`, `radius`, and `color` are finite, `radius` is positive,
and `thickness` is finite and nonzero.
Fill a polygon over a copy of the input, following `fillPoly`: the
`points` matrix carries `[N, 2]` vertex coordinates and every pixel
whose center falls inside the even-odd winding of the polygon takes
`color`. `color` applies to every plane.
# Errors
Returns an error unless the image is a nonempty FP32 NCHW/CHW image,
`points` is an FP32 `[N, 2]` matrix with at least 3 vertices on the
same runtime, and `color` is finite.
Per-pixel corner response over each plane: 3x3 Sobel gradients feed
windowed second moments `M = [sum Ix^2, sum IxIy; sum IxIy, sum Iy^2]`
inside a `block_size` x `block_size` box. `Harris` emits
`det(M) - k * trace(M)^2`; `MinEigen` emits the smaller eigenvalue
of `M` (Shi-Tomasi). Borders reflect101 like `cornerHarris`.
The response map shares the input geometry; combine with a local
max pass for candidate keypoints.
# Errors
Returns an error unless the image is a nonempty FP32 NCHW/CHW
image, `k` is finite, and `block_size` is odd and at least 3.
FAST corner response per plane on the radius-3 circle of 16
samples: for each pixel the score is the largest deviation `t`
such that `arc_length` contiguous circle samples are all brighter
than `center + t` or all darker than `center - t`, zero when no
such arc exists. Pixels within 3 of the border score 0.0.
The response map shares the input geometry; non-maximum
suppression and thresholding select candidate keypoints.
# Errors
Returns an error unless the image is a nonempty FP32 NCHW/CHW
image and `arc_length` is in `9..=16`.
Brute-force Hamming descriptor matching: for each row of `query`,
scan every row of `train` and record the two smallest XOR popcount
distances. Both inputs are U8 `[N, D]` matrices sharing `D`.
Returns an F32 `[N_query, 4]` matrix whose rows are
`(best_index, best_distance, second_index, second_distance)`,
mirroring `BFMatcher.knnMatch(k=2)` on `NORM_HAMMING`. Rows with
fewer than two candidates fill unused columns with `-1`.
# Errors
Returns an error unless both inputs are nonempty U8 matrices with
identical trailing descriptor width and at least one row each.
Bounded `goodFeaturesToTrack` selection over a per-plane corner
response map: pixels scoring above `quality * plane_max` survive
radius suppression when no strictly stronger candidate lies within
`min_distance` (ties break by lower linear index). Survivors claim
atomic slots per plane up to `max_corners`; slot order is
unsorted unlike OpenCV's score-descending emission.
Returns `(keypoints, counts)`: an F32 `[planes, max_corners, 3]`
matrix of `(x, y, score)` rows holding `min(count, max_corners)`
valid entries followed by zeros, and a U32 `[planes]` survivor
count matrix (may exceed `max_corners` when slots truncate).
A `max_corners` of zero selects `height * width` per plane.
# Errors
Returns an error unless the image is a nonempty FP32 NCHW/CHW
image and both `quality` and `min_distance` are finite with
quality in [0, 1] and min_distance >= 0.
Bounded ORB keypoint + steered rBRIEF descriptor pipeline,
following `ORB::detectAndCompute`. Each pyramid level runs the
existing corner_fast + good_features_to_track stages (FAST-9
response, quality-thresholded radius suppression), then a
describe stage computes the intensity-centroid orientation over
a 31x31 patch and a 256-bit steered BRIEF descriptor using the
OpenCV bit_pattern_31_ test pairs. Scale factor is 2x per level
via pyr_down.
Returns `(keypoints, descriptors, counts)`: an F32
`[planes, max_features, 6]` matrix of `(x, y, angle_radians,
score, level, size)` rows in level-0 coordinates, a U32
`[planes, max_features, 8]` matrix of descriptor words, and a
U32 `[planes]` claimed-slot count (may exceed `max_features`).
Slot order is unordered across a level's survivors. A
`max_features` of zero selects `height * width` per plane.
# Errors
Returns an error unless the image is a nonempty FP32 NCHW/CHW
image, `levels` >= 1, `edge` >= 18 (rotated test-pair support),
quality is in [0, 1], and min_distance is finite and >= 0.
Sparse Lucas-Kanade optical flow with image pyramids,
following `calcOpticalFlowPyrLK`. Each pyramid level runs
one `flow_lk_refine` dispatch from the coarsest level to
level 0 over `2 * window + 1` windows with the same point
set applied to every image plane; the tracked estimate
carries between levels in a `[planes, N, 2]` state buffer
and the last level writes status and error maps.
`points` is an F32 `[N, 2]` matrix of `(x, y)` source
positions in level-0 pixel coordinates. `window` is the
half-window radius. Returns `(next_points, status, error)`:
the tracked F32 `[planes, N, 2]` positions, an F32
`[planes, N]` found/lost mask, and an F32 `[planes, N]`
RMS patch-residual error; status 0 rows carry the final
unconverged estimate.
# Errors
Returns an error unless both images are nonempty FP32
NCHW/CHW images with identical shape, layout, and format,
`points` is a nonempty F32 `[N, 2]` matrix, `levels`,
`window`, and `iterations` are >= 1, `min_eigen` is finite
and positive, and the coarsest level still fits the full
window.
Dense Farneback optical flow over a 2x image pyramid,
following `calcOpticalFlowFarneback`. Each level expands
both frames into polynomial coefficient maps through two
separable weighted-least-squares passes (`flow_expand_v`
then `flow_expand_h`), then relaxes the flow field with
`iterations` Jacobi `flow_update` dispatches over a
`2 * window + 1` averaging neighbourhood. The coarsest
level starts from a zero field; finer levels initialize
from the 2x-upsampled coarser solution.
`window` is the half-window radius of the update
averaging neighbourhood and `poly_n` the half-support of
the gaussian-weighted polynomial fit. Returns the F32
`[planes, 2, H, W]` flow field at level-0 resolution with
x displacement in channel 0 and y displacement in
channel 1.
# Errors
Returns an error unless both images are nonempty FP32
NCHW/CHW images with identical shape, layout, and format,
`levels`, `window`, `iterations`, and `poly_n` are >= 1,
`poly_sigma` is finite and positive, and the coarsest
level still fits the polynomial support.
Block-matching stereo disparity over the horizontal search
range [0, num_disparities), following cv::StereoBM. The
`stereo_sad` pass builds a [planes, num_disparities, H, W]
sum-of-absolute-differences volume over an odd block_size
window; `stereo_wta` then keeps the per-pixel argmin, applies
the `uniqueness` percent runner-up margin test (0 disables),
and refines the winner with a symmetric parabola on the
neighbouring costs. Pixels outside the border region where
the matching window fits for every disparity, and uniqueness
losers, are marked -1; the valid range otherwise starts at 0.
Returns the F32 [planes, 1, H, W] disparity map.
# Errors
Returns an error unless both images are nonempty FP32
NCHW/CHW images with identical shape, layout, and format,
num_disparities >= 1, block_size is odd and >= 3, and the
image fits the combined block and disparity support.
Per-pixel reprojection of a disparity map into 3D
coordinates, following cv::reprojectImageTo3D. For each
pixel it evaluates (X, Y, Z, W) = Q * [x, y, disparity, 1]
with the row-major 4x4 F32 matrix `q`, then writes the
normalized coordinates X/W, Y/W, Z/W. `disparity` must be
F32 [planes, 1, H, W] (the stereo_bm output layout) and
`q` F32 [4, 4]; the homogeneous divide is unguarded, so a
degenerate last row surfaces as inf/NaN. Returns the F32
[planes, 3, H, W] coordinate map.
# Errors
Returns an error unless `disparity` is F32 with shape
[planes, 1, H, W] and `q` is F32 [4, 4] on the same
runtime.
Non-local means denoising over a search window,
following cv::fastNlMeansDenoising. Each output pixel is
the weighted mean of samples in the (search_window)^2
neighbourhood with weights exp(-d / h^2), where d is the
patch SSD over an odd template_window normalized by its
area; the center weight equals the largest neighbour
weight so a uniform region stays untouched. Returns an
image with identical shape, layout, and format.
# Errors
Returns an error unless `input` is a nonempty FP32
NCHW/CHW image, `h` is finite and positive, and both
windows are odd and at least 3.
Pyramid mean-shift edge-preserving smoothing, following
cv::pyrMeanShiftFiltering. The image is downsampled
max_level times with pyr_down; each level then runs a
per-pixel mean-shift pass that, for up to five
iterations, averages the (2*sp+1)^2 window samples whose
channel-vector distance stays below sr and adopts that
mean position and color, converging when the spatial
shift drops under one pixel. Coarse-to-fine levels seed
their starting color from the parent's converged result.
Channels participate as one color vector per plane
pixel; returns an image with identical shape, layout,
and format.
# Errors
Returns an error unless `input` is a nonempty FP32
NCHW/CHW image with at most 4 channels, sp/sr are finite
and positive, max_level is in [1, 4], and the coarsest
level still fits the spatial window support.

variants.name: Nearest
variants.doc: Select the source pixel containing the scaled output coordinate.

variants.name: Bilinear
variants.doc: Use half-pixel-center bilinear sampling with `align_corners = false`.

variants.name: Area
variants.doc: Box average over the scaled source rectangle (downscale); degenerates to nearest-pixel replication for upscale.

variants.name: Cubic
variants.doc: Bicubic convolution over the 4x4 source neighborhood using the Keys a=-0.75 kernel.

variants.name: Lanczos
variants.doc: Lanczos-4 sinc resampling over the 8x8 source neighborhood with downscale filter widening.

types.name: BorderMode
types.doc: Sampling behavior for coordinates outside an image.

variants.name: Reflect
variants.doc: Reflect coordinates while repeating the edge pixel.

variants.name: Reflect101
variants.doc: Reflect coordinates without repeating the edge pixel.

types.name: HistogramComparison
types.doc: Row-wise histogram comparison metric used by [`compare_hist`].

variants.name: Correlation
variants.doc: Pearson correlation between centered rows; `1.0` is a perfect match.

variants.name: ChiSquare
variants.doc: Chi-square distance over paired buckets; `0.0` is a perfect match.

variants.name: Intersection
variants.doc: Normalized per-bucket minimum sum; `1.0` is a perfect match.

variants.name: Bhattacharyya
variants.doc: Bhattacharyya distance between normalized rows; `0.0` is a perfect match.

variants.name: Harris
variants.doc: Harris response `det(M) - k * trace(M)^2` over the windowed second moments.
